description: Double-cab diesel pickup truck, the other dominant Thai pickup alongside the Hilux, favoured for heavy hauling.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Double-cab diesel pickup truck, four doors, wide horizontal-bar grille with swept headlamps, squared wheel arches, open cargo bed with a bed liner and drop tailgate, running boards Materials: Solid enamel paint with grey plastic bumpers, chrome grille surround, scratched bed liner, mud spray along the sills and rear arches.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: Isuzu D-Max / Isuzu Motors. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.88. 6,302/8,000 triangles, 4/6 draw calls, 3/4 materials, 4/8 unique geometries, one 512 px canvas at 1.3 MB, factory 76 ms.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 1.87 x 1.77 x 5.30 m over the body (mirrors to 2.15) against a declared 1.87 x 1.79 x 5.30; the proxy normalises to 2.93 lengths tall against the real 2.96, so the band table has no declared-aspect residual to explain.
featureReviews.notes: Heights read off the proxy side elevation (roof 1.00 H, belt and rail 0.68 H, wheel top 0.40 H, sill 0.26 H); stations bonnet 0.03-0.27 L, cab 0.30-0.60 L, bed 0.60-0.98 L; two full doors with the B-pillar at 0.45 L. Second pass: shoulders, roof corners and nose filleted, smooth-shaded with a continuous fillet from the cab back to the rake; the slab read of the first build is gone at every azimuth.

featureReviews.evidence: Chrome-surrounded grille with five bars and a badge between wrap-around lamps over a grey bumper with corners wrapped round the nose, air dam, fog recesses and plates; side steps, 100 mm grey flares, door mouldings, mirrors on stems, handles, shut lines, indicators, tail-lamp posts beside the tailgate; windscreen and rear pane both visible (both were buried in the first build).
featureReviews.notes: Built as tinted boxes on one white material, each standing proud of the shell.

featureReviews.evidence: Four instanced wheels off one lathe with the rim a step apart from the tyre; pivots wheel-front-l/r and wheel-rear-l/r on the axle at each hub, exposed on sculptRuntime.
featureReviews.notes: Pressed-steel wheels in the plate (region-tyre 0.86): dished rim #8a877f with a #4a4842 vent ring and hub cap against tyre #56534d with #48463f tread lugs.

featureReviews.evidence: Paint material carries the per-channel-max envelope #6f7953; clean #4d7953 and mud #6f6650 both ride a 512 px canvas as linear-space ratios; wash solid to the sill and out at 1.04 m, spray zoned behind the wheels, bonnet and roof keyed clean. Rendered lower door luma 71 and bed side 74 against the hole gate's 58.
featureReviews.notes: Ratio formed in linear space; roof and bonnet kept clean by keying upward faces into the tile's clean band.

notes: 5.3 m double-cab length puts this in the hero budget class, past the vehicle category's 4.5 m prior -- the estimate is the real vehicle. Shares its massing and cab proportions with the Toyota Hilux; the two are kept separate because their grille, lamp and arch treatment read as visibly different trucks, and a street scene wants the variety.
